chunks: Ja'far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. Amer narrated to us from his uncle Abdullah b. Amer from Muhammad b. Abi Umayr from Aban b. Uthman from Aban b. Taghlub from Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali al-Baqir from his father from his grandfather (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever wants a way to me and wants my hand in his intercession on the Day of Resurrection should connect with my Ahl al-Bayt and bring joy to them.

key_terms.أشفع: I intercede - the Prophet's intercession on behalf of believers
key_terms.أهل بيتي: My Ahl al-Bayt - the Prophet's household
key_terms.التوسل: Tawassul - seeking a means or way to approach God through intermediaries
key_terms.يوم القيامة: Day of Resurrection - the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about connecting with Ahl al-Bayt and intercession on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) teaches that the path to his intercession on the Day of Judgment is through loving and supporting his household (Ahl al-Bayt). This hadith, narrated through a chain reaching the 5th Imam al-Baqir (AS), establishes a direct connection between caring for the Prophet's family and earning his intercession in the Hereafter. The concept of tawassul (seeking means of approach to God through righteous intermediaries) is central to Shia theology.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from his uncle `Abdullah b. `Amer from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Aban b. `Uthman from Aban b. Taghlub from Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir from his father from his grandfather (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Whoever wants a way (tawassul) to me and wants my hand in his intercession on the Day of Resurrection should connect with my Ahl al-Bayt and bring joy to them.
